sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  max(T2.ranking_points) FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id JOIN matches AS T3 ON T1.player_id  =  T3.winner_id GROUP BY T1.player_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
